title: Quaint Tender Spanish Octopus Pulpo A La Gallega
description: A tangy and tender Spanish dish featuring octopus, tobiko, and kombu cold extract, perfect for a romantic dinner. This flexitarian friendly recipe is a twist on the traditional Pulpo A La Gallega.

ingredients.name: octopus
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite sized pieces

instructions: Rinse the octopus under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the octopus and cook for 5 minutes until it starts to brown.
Add the kombu cold extract, tobiko, and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes until the octopus is tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
Garnish with additional parsley and tobiko if desired.
